description: CT v85: exactly the v83 configuration (same architecture, caps, cat splits, seed, log1p, no aux branch, common-energy-spectrum sample weights) trained on the radiological-masked volume images (_radmask, 40 cm / 2 MeV image-level blob mask). Selection is driven by the UNMASKED file lists so the RandomState stream - and therefore the validation and test selections - are identical to v80/v83/v84; only the pixels come from the masked product.
